01

“For the accustoming of Quraysh”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 106:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
For the accustoming of Quraysh [Quraysh: 1], he said: “They had become accustomed to that, so neither the winter journey nor the summer journey was burdensome to them.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ [قريش: 1] قَالَ: «كَانُوا أَلِفُوا ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِمْ رِحْلَةُ شِتَاءٍ وَلَا صَيْفٍ»

02

“and secured them from fear”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 106:4).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and secured them from fear [Quraysh: 4], he said: “He made them secure from every enemy in their sanctuary.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ [قريش: 4] قَالَ: «آمَنَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ عَدُوٍّ فِي حَرَمِهِمْ»
